title: Mariner Payments — account outreach notes
content:
Quick scratchpad for Mariner Payments outreach — high level notes, hypotheses, and email/call drafts. Not polished.

Background/context notes:
- Mariner Payments = mid-market payment processor (card present + online), strong in hospitality and retail. Regional leadership in US Northeast and Southeast.
- Likely priorities: reduce decline rates, lower payment processing fees for merchants, fraud reduction, streamline reconciliation for merchant platforms.
- Tech stack hints from job postings / LinkedIn: internal services in Go + Python, Postgres, Kafka used for eventing; mentions of GPU usage? Not directly.
- Data sensitivity: PCI scope is obviously critical — private deployment conversations will need clear KMS/HSM + SOC2 + PCI alignment.

Why Redwood might matter to them (angle hypotheses):
- Use case: merchant-facing conversational support (chat transcripts -> action suggestions) + automated dispute summarization + embeddings for semantic search over merchant policies and SLAs.
- Cost sensitivity: they run at scale but margins are tight — push Dedicated or Private with cost predictability vs hosted.
- Latency needs: live cashier/terminal assistance might need <200ms tail — emphasize low-latency inference and routing to region.
- Compliance: highlight Private (VPC/on-prem) and KMS integration; show audit/logging capability in Console.

Key contacts (found via LinkedIn / org chart):
- CTO: Daniel Holt — background payments infra; past infra role at mid-sized fintech.
- Head of Ops/Product: Maria Lopez — likely owner for merchant tools and workflow automation.
- Security/Compliance: Ben Thompson (Sr. Security Engineer) — PCI/HIPAA reviewer.
- BD / Partnerships: Rachel Kim — owns ISV partnerships and channel integrations.

Priority storylines for outreach (short -> to the point):
1) Cost predictability and predictable SLAs for mission-critical payment APIs.
2) Private deployments + KMS/HSM + compliance-first chat (we can run inference inside their VPC).
3) Drop-in for merchant-facing search and dispute summarization — measurable time savings in dispute resolution.

Objections to anticipate + short counters:
- "We can't send cardholder data to external APIs." -> Counter: Private deployments + tokenization + selective redaction + runtime KMS + audited logs; offer a short technical doc and redaction pattern examples.
- "We're already using vendor X for embeddings/chat." -> Counter: Emphasize unit-cost and latency differences, deterministic rollouts, and hybrid routing (route heavy or expensive calls to cheaper quantized models). Offer a short A/B test proposal.
- "Integration cost too high." -> Counter: Starter template + plugin for common gateways (Stripe, Adyen) + SDKs; propose a 2-week POC with a stubbed dataset.
- "We need PCI scope details." -> Counter: Provide compliance checklist, SOC2 + sample MSA language, and talk through where Redwood sits in scope (we can be out of scope with Private/on-prem).

Email drafts (short variants):
1) Intro (concise):
Subject: Quick idea to reduce dispute resolution time at Mariner
Hi Maria — I noticed Mariner runs a lot of mid-market hospitality merchants and that dispute cycles are a recurring ops drag. We’ve helped similar processors cut dispute triage time by ~40% using embeddings+auto-summaries and a low-latency inference stack that can live inside customer-controlled VPCs. Would you be open to a 20-min sync next week to walk through a lightweight POC?
— Aisha

2) Technical/intro to security: 
Subject: PCI-friendly inference option for merchant automation
Hi Ben — I’m with Redwood Inference (inference platform for LLMs). We have a Private deployment pattern that keeps call traffic inside customer VPCs, integrates with KMS/HSM for keys, and provides audit logs useful for PCI reviews. Happy to share an architecture diagram and a short checklist for your auditors. When’s a good time?
— Aisha

Cold LinkedIn message (short):
Hi Rachel — saw your note about ISV integrations at Mariner. We’ve built a playbook for payment ISVs to add merchant-facing search, dispute summarization, and conversational receipts with predictable latency and cost. Would love to share a 5-slide sketch. Interested?

Call script bullets (first call discovery):
- Quick intros (2 min) + confirm agenda (POC goals, data constraints, timeline).
- Discovery: which merchant workflows are highest pain? (disputes, chargebacks, merchant support, reconciliation).
- Data flows: what live data can we access? Are there redaction/tokenization steps?
- KPI ask: what metric would make a POC a success? (time-to-resolution, false positive reduction, engineer-hours saved).
- Security: clarify PCI boundary expectations. Who owns the compliance sign-off?
- Next steps: propose 2-week POC + sandbox, list of access needs, and technical POC owner.

POC sketch (2-week, low friction):
- Week 0: Kickoff + architecture alignment + stub dataset (anonymized chargeback/dispute records + merchant chat logs).
- Week 1: Integrate Redwood SDK into sandbox, run simple summarization pipeline + embeddings, demo results to ops team.
- Week 2: Iterate on prompts, surface model metrics (latency, token cost), produce a short ROI estimate for dispute resolution time saved.
- Deliverable: working demo + deck with metric estimates + compliance notes.

Metrics & signals to track during POC:
- Avg summary generation latency (p95)
- Token cost per record and projected monthly cost at scale
- Time saved in human triage (cadence study)
- False positive/negative rate for automated suggestions (ops acceptance rate)

Notes-to-self / unanswered questions to research before outreach:
- Find any Mariner public docs mentioning 'merchant dispute automation' or 'chargeback team size' (LinkedIn mentions?).
- Verify if Mariner uses Stripe/Adyen/FirstData (one would change integration approach).
- Get internal sample redaction templates to share as reference for Ben (security).
- Ask Solutions Eng for a one-pager: "Redwood PCI-safe deployment patterns" (link to include).

Potential pilot pricing language (for initial convo):
- 2-week POC: waived platform fee + usage-based token charges (estimated at $X based on sample set) + optional 30-day extension for $Y flat.
- Follow-on: monthly reserved capacity if latency/throughput matters + pricing bands for hosted vs dedicated vs private.

Next steps (short):
- Pull a one-pager for PCI private deployment (ask SE: Ravi).
- Quick run-through with Solutions Eng on likely integration hooks (Liam).
- Draft outreach to Maria + Ben + Rachel (split A/B test email 1/2).
- Add Mariner to outbound cadence: 2 touches via email -> LinkedIn -> follow-up call.

Random snippets / brain dump:
- Could show a simple before/after: verbatim dispute note -> 2-sentence auto-summary + suggested resolution category.
- Possible low-friction win: enable a 'suggested reply' in merchant ops UI (copy/paste) to speed triage.
- If they push back on cost, propose model-pricing: route 80% of low-sensitivity calls to a quantized cheaper model and only route high-value to the higher-cost model.

End of scratchpad.
__notes: working doc; intentionally informal; keep private
